g.text: Three architectures · nine conditional model points · fixed architecture within each case
300 / 350 / 400 K are finite engineering design scenarios; 350 K is a warm reference, not a statistical median.
Native automatic sizing is retained; these are not fixed-chip PVT or statistical bounds. Decimal MB/s = 10⁶ Byte/s.
Connecting lines identify paired scenarios within each case; points retain the source summary coordinates.
